title: Event Harmonizer and Telemetry Intake Heuristics
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Console backend services emit a wide variety of usage events (API calls, token billing, embeddings calls, route-level traces). The current pipeline rejects or drops partially-formed events, creating blind spots in analytics and causing downstream evaluation regressions. Goal: implement an ingestion-stage 'Event Harmonizer' that uses deterministic heuristics and probabilistic typing to normalize, enrich, and safely accept partial events while maintaining schema observability and strict downstream guarantees. The harmonizer will sit in the intake path before canonical validators and provide: 1) best-effort field normalization (timestamps, enums, numeric coercion), 2) lineage metadata (original payload, harmonized payload, heuristic confidence score), 3) pluggable transform hooks for per-product rules, and 4) a progressive acceptance policy (accept-with-warn, accept-with-enrich, reject). This ticket scopes the backend service, schema for harmonized output, sampling/telemetry to measure heuristics accuracy, and fallbacks to strict validation when SLA requires exact typing.
acceptance_criteria: Event Harmonizer service implemented and deployed to staging behind a feature flag
Harmonizer produces a harmonized_payload field and a confidence_score for every accepted event
Pipeline can route events to: strict-validator, harmonizer-accepted, or quarantine based on policy
End-to-end ingestion throughput on staging >= 8k events/sec with <200ms additional p95 latency
Sampling dashboard shows heuristic precision/recall for field recovery (>=95% for timestamps, >=90% for numeric coercions)
Automated tests cover 80+ edge cases from historical invalid event dumps
Rollout plan and kill switch documented in Confluence with linked runbooks and PRs
tasks: Design harmonized event schema and lineage metadata format (document in Confluence)
Implement heuristic library: timestamp parsing, enum fuzzy-match, number coercion, base64 detection
Add confidence scoring and error categorization for each heuristic
Create transform hook interface for product-specific enrichment rules
Wire harmonizer into Kafka intake topic as a pre-validator stream processor
Add gating feature flag and feature-flagged rollout to staging
Build sampling exporter to BigQuery for heuristic evaluation
Add e2e load tests and latency SLO measurement harness
Create quarantine workflow and dashboard for low-confidence events
Write migration plan for consumers to handle harmonized_payload field
notes: 2026-03-02: Spike completed comparing timestamp parsers (chrono vs custom heuristics). Chose custom multi-format approach after test corpus showed 6% better recall on historical events.
2026-03-05: Jonah implemented initial parse/normalize functions and benchmarked single-threaded throughput ~3.2k eps. Need to parallelize and use batch processing for target throughput.

2026-03-09: Design review w/ PM and Observability. Decided harmonizer will attach 'harmonized_payload' and keep original event for auditing. Observability will record heuristic reasons as tags for downstream tracing.

2026-03-11: Security flagged potential PII enrichment risk when heuristics guess user identifiers. Added requirement to mask/omit high-risk guessed fields and route to quarantine unless confidence >= 0.95.

2026-03-13: Load test on k8s staging with 6 replicas and batched processing achieved 12k eps p50 latency + 180ms p95 overhead. Sufficient margin for initial rollout behind feature flag. Still need to add backpressure handling with the ingress proxy.
